text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — final draft of the release notes for v1.12 is ready. Need ops + sales + legal sign-off before we blast the internal announcement tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Pinning plan: runtime v3.2.0 (primary), fallback v3.1.2. Snippet below, please skim and call out anything blocking.

Maya: Release note draft:
- Runtime: upgrade to inference-runtime v3.2.0 (perf + KV cache fixes).
- Models: default model mapping unchanged; new opt-quant profile applied to small models.
- Canaries: gradual rollout, 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2h windows.
- Rollback: automatic fallback to v3.1.2 on 5xx spike or latency > 2x baseline for 10m.
- Observability: new per-route token cost breakdown in console.

Sam: LGTM on copy. Can we start canary earlier for APAC window? If we do 09:00 UTC we hit APAC peak rather than EU.

Leo: Quick question on rollback thresholds — is the 5xx spike defined as >50 errors/min across the canary or relative to baseline? We should be explicit.

Anna: I updated the internal blurb to call out customer-impacting changes and added the legal-approved wording for data handling. Link: https://redwood.internal/rn/1.12 (private)

Maya: Good call, Leo. Change to: "rollback if 5xx rate > 2x baseline AND >= 30 errors/min sustained for 10m". That avoids noisy small-sample fluctuations. Sam — okay to shift canary start to 09:00 UTC?

Sam: 09:00 UTC works for us. Ops can monitor. I'll be on-watch for first 45 minutes.

Maya: Deploybot plan (ops please run at T-10m):
```
/deploy schedule --release v1.12 --canary 10% --steps "10%,50%,100%" --step-duration 40m --start 2025-04-20T09:00:00Z --pin runtime=v3.2.0 --fallback runtime=v3.1.2
```

Maya: Also: pin the release note in the RN channel, and add the per-route trace links in the announcement. Anna can you confirm the internal blurb matches the release note bullets?

Anna: Confirmed — blurb synced and legal checked. I added a short FAQ line about quantized models to avoid surprise.

Leo: Ops checklist I want in the runbook before we start:
- smoke test (embed + chat) on staging -> pass
- run cost estimate script (cost delta shouldn't exceed 8%)
- preflight: seed 1K requests to canary pool and check latency p95 <= baseline*1.5
- set rollback policy in deploybot (as above)

Sam: I'll run the smoke + cost script at T-30m and post results.

deploybot: Scheduled deployment queued by maya — release=v1.12 start=2025-04-20T09:00:00Z canary=10% steps=[10%,50%,100%] step_duration=40m pin=runtime:v3.2.0 fallback=runtime:v3.1.2. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/v1.12

Maya: Thanks — please react with :thumbsup: once you have control checks done. I'll send the internal announcement at 09:20 UTC (post-canary 10% success) to the company channel and pin RN in eng docs.

Sam: :thumbsup: posted smoke results at 08:30 UTC — all green.

Leo: :thumbsup: preflight checks passed, latency within target. Rollback thresholds set in deploybot.

Anna: :thumbsup: blurb pinned and RN link posted in docs.

Maya: Perfect. I'll run the blast at 09:20 UTC and watch first 30m. If anything odd, revert to fallback and notify on-call.

Sam: Copy that. Oncall is @sam-oncall for first hour.

Maya: Closing thread — thanks everyone.
